po_authorization_ref: Product-Owner decision of 2026-08-13, 'D19 — PHASE 4 IS ACCEPTED AND CLOSED at VERIFIED LIVE-DARK / NO-FINANCIAL-TRAFFIC maturity.' It names the accepted software candidate, both CI runs and both evidence artifacts, accepts the T0043 live evidence, requires repository-only acceptance and closure, requires six limitations to be preserved without promotion, requires one wording correction to be made FORWARD rather than by rewriting T0043, and requires the single Phase-4 pull request to be opened and left OPEN and UNMERGED.
history_note: T0030 through T0043 are PRESERVED unchanged. This transition records the Product Owner's acceptance and closure of Phase 4 and the repository-only synchronization that follows it. No historical receipt was rewritten, no historical evidence was restated, and no appliance was contacted.

accepted_basis.live_evidence: T0043 — the WS-L controlled live-DARK deployment on the development appliance
accepted_basis.separation_note: Three kinds of evidence are deliberately kept apart and must not be conflated. SOFTWARE-CI evidence says the delivered code passes its own authoritative gate on a disposable database. T0043 LIVE evidence says that same code, deployed to a real appliance, behaved as specified with every flag OFF. The PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION is neither of those: it is the judgement that the two together are sufficient for LIVE-DARK maturity, made by the Product Owner and not by the implementer.

accepted_limitations.subject: C35 external archival receipt authority
accepted_limitations.statement: No external archival receipt authority exists. The implemented compliance archive, its digest and the purge gate are ACCEPTED BECAUSE THEY FAIL CLOSED: p4_assert_compliance_archived refuses without a verified receipt, and the receipt flag cannot be set without external evidence even by the database superuser. Cross-customer purge is consequently UNAVAILABLE and remains so until a real external receipt authority exists.

accepted_limitations.subject: C38 real-financial acceptance
accepted_limitations.statement: Real-financial acceptance (Contract §9c Tier-3 3C) remains OUTSIDE Phase 4 and requires a separate future Product-Owner authorization. Nothing in this closure advances it.

accepted_limitations.subject: financial restore management marker
accepted_limitations.statement: /etc/stayconnect/financial-restore-generation.json is NOT installed on the development appliance. This is recorded as a PRE-FINANCIAL-ENABLE PREREQUISITE: it must be initialized/installed and verified through the supported process before any future real financial traffic is authorized. It is not a defect in the delivered software and it is not satisfied by anything in this closure.
accepted_limitations.prerequisite_for: any future authorization of real financial traffic

accepted_limitations.subject: legacy live-session continuity
accepted_limitations.statement: Still NOT PROVEN, carried unchanged from Phase 3: no real legacy guest was online during the authorized live windows. It must NOT be inferred as PASS from WS-L row counts — the public-schema row growth observed during WS-L is ordinary legacy activity and says nothing about session continuity across a change.

accepted_limitations.subject: payment providers
accepted_limitations.statement: No real payment-provider adapter exists and no real-provider behaviour has been accepted by this DARK closure. The payment domain was verified against deterministic in-process doubles only; the provider-reference model is a capability contract, not an integration with any named provider.

accepted_limitations.subject: per-property financial onboarding
accepted_limitations.statement: Per-property Tier-2 financial onboarding remains MANDATORY before any property can be financially enabled. Hotel ID 2 remains financially UNAPPROVED.

forward_corrections.what_was_said: T0043 and the WS-L report stated that 'no role at all' can execute iam_v2.p4_record_compliance_receipt.
forward_corrections.why_it_is_wrong: It overstates a measurement into a permanent impossibility. What was measured is that no DEPLOYED runtime, service or PUBLIC role holds EXECUTE on it. The function exists deliberately, so that the day a real external archival authority exists the shape is already correct and auditable; the owner of the schema can still reach it, and a future authorized grant is exactly how the capability would be turned on. Saying 'no role at all' would make the C35 design read as permanently dead code rather than as a capability that is intentionally unreachable from the current runtime.
forward_corrections.accurate_statement: No deployed runtime, service or PUBLIC role is AUTHORIZED to call iam_v2.p4_record_compliance_receipt, and it is unreachable from the current runtime. The controlled function exists for a future real external archival authority. Measured on the appliance: 0 of sc_payment_runtime, sc_payment_outcome, sc_commerce_runtime, sc_financial_operator, sc_financial_readonly, svc_edged, svc_scd, svc_acctd, svc_netd and PUBLIC hold EXECUTE.
forward_corrections.method: Corrected FORWARD in the current-state surfaces and in the Phase-4 closure documents. T0043 is NOT rewritten: it records what was said when it was written, and this entry records what is accurate now.

repository_only.note: This closure round touched the repository only. The appliance was left exactly as WS-L left it: the Phase-4 schema and binaries deployed, every flag OFF, zero financial egress.

acceptance_verdict: ACCEPTED_AND_CLOSED — Phase 4 is ACCEPTED AND CLOSED AT VERIFIED LIVE-DARK / NO-FINANCIAL-TRAFFIC MATURITY (decision D19). LIVE-DARK and NOT ENABLED: every Phase-4 feature flag is OFF, every Phase-4 route returns 404 on the running appliance, legacy public-schema IAM remains the sole authentication authority, iam_v2 holds 68 tables and ZERO rows, and no PS, PA, folio debit, provider CHARGE/REFUND, paid access or reversal has ever occurred. Six limitations are accepted and preserved without promotion. Acceptance authorizes no enablement, no cutover, no Production change and no merge.
